title: Polling
definition: Short Polling is the client making repetitive HTTP requests to the server at fixed intervals (e.g., every 5 seconds) to check for new data.
simpleExplanation: Kids in the back seat constantly asking 'Are we there yet? Are we there yet? Are we there yet?'

answers.question: What is the main tradeoff of Polling?
answers.answer: Usually a tradeoff between Server CPU usage, TTFB (Time to First Byte), and Client CPU usage.
